relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: These studies indicated that this putative proinflammatory GPCR was increased within 15-30 minutes of treatment with a clinically relevant amount (3 μM) of paclitaxel.

relationships.subject: KLS-13019
relationships.evidence_quote: the 16 hours treatment with KLS-13019 resulted in a concentration-dependent decrease in paclitaxel-induced increases in NLRP3 with an IC50 (140 ± 72 pM)

relationships.subject: KLS-13019
relationships.evidence_quote: a concentration-dependent decrease in IL-1β was observed in cell bodies, with an IC50 of 156 ± 45 pM

relationships.subject: KLS-13019
relationships.evidence_quote: increases in β-arrestin produced by 16 μM LPI were completely blocked by 30 μM KLS-13019

relationships.subject: CY-09
relationships.evidence_quote: the increase in IR area of NLRP3 in neurites elicited by 1 nM LPIA was completely blocked by pretreatment with 10 μM CY-09

key_findings: KLS-13019, a GPR55 antagonist, reversed paclitaxel- and LPIA-induced increases in GPR55, NLRP3 and IL-1β and viability loss in DRG and hippocampal cultures.
